name: Sunlight
tagline: Follows the money behind a media narrative, briefed in two cards
description: A claim examiner for media narratives. Pick a story and it traces the funding and interests sitting behind it, then packages the findings into short glance briefs sized for a skim. It will also draft a two-card X post for your review , drafts only, so the framing that goes out is the one you approved.
author: acornsoftai
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
